payload.rationale: Extends the best prior result (resnet18, 0.9924 at epoch 6) by: (1) increasing hidden 32→48 and depth 3→4 for ~30% more capacity to capture finer nuclear/glandular morphology; (2) lowering LR 5e-4→3e-4 for more stable convergence with the added parameters; (3) enabling class_weighting to directly address the 1.63x imbalance (classes range 7.9K–12.9K samples), which was untested in all prior runs; (4) raising label_smoothing 0.05→0.1 for better-calibrated probabilities on the 9-class problem; (5) increasing dropout 0.1→0.15 as a mild regularizer for the extra capacity; (6) extending early_stopping_patience to 8 epochs since the prior best peaked at epoch 6, giving the model room to continue improving. Augmentations (hflip+vflip) and standardize normalization are retained from the winning config. Weight decay stays at 1e-4 to avoid over-regularizing the already well-performing architecture.
